content.text: In Nigeria, where Stripe is unavailable, and digital creators are forced to rely on workarounds, the infrastructure problem is clear: rent, not own, and be at the mercy of [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-solutions-zimbabwean-digital-sellers-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/everything-about-selling-beats-online-crypto-payments-guide-2|COREMERCH guide to everything]]-you-need|Payment Solutions]] platforms. But what if creators could own their store infrastructure, processing payments directly with [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/get-crypto-payments-tanzanian-online-sellers-working-today|crypto]], and avoiding account freezes and suspensions? That's where COREMERCH's sovereign commerce infrastructure comes in, providing digital creators with a fully operational online store complete with automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: Sovereign Commerce Infrastructure for Digital Creators at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/coremerch-sovereign-stack-deployment-guide-which-architecture-actually-4. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: Sovereign Commerce Infrastructure for Digital Creators

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers

COREMERCH offers three options for digital creators: the Sovereign Starter Stack, the Edge Commerce Stack, and the Sovereign Blueprint. The Sovereign Starter Stack deploys a basic store infrastructure in 48 hours, complete with GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, and automatic crypto payment processing through NOWPayments. The Edge Commerce Stack takes it to the next level, with a more advanced store infrastructure, SPF/DKIM/DMARC configured, and end-to-end testing. The Sovereign Blueprint provides complete documentation for all five stacks, full source code, and a NOWPayments integration guide.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

COREMERCH's sovereign commerce infrastructure is specifically designed for countries where Stripe, PayPal, and other payment platforms are restricted or unavailable. With NOWPayments, creators can process payments directly with crypto, avoiding the need for bank accounts or credit cards. This means that creators in Zimbabwe, Venezuela, and other countries where financial isolation is a reality can finally sell their digital products online without relying on workarounds.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

When it comes to payment speed, fees, and real costs, COREMERCH's sovereign commerce infrastructure shines. With NOWPayments, creators can process payments instantly, with fees as low as 0.5%. This is in stark contrast to traditional payment platforms, which can charge up to 3% in fees and take days to process payments. And with the Complete Builder Kit, creators can build, deploy, and scale their store infrastructure without breaking the bank.
A wallet you control cannot be frozen by anyone — that is the fundamental difference from a platform account balance.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

One of the key benefits of COREMERCH's sovereign commerce infrastructure is ownership, automation, and delivery. Creators own their store infrastructure, data, and customer lists, giving them full control over their online business. Automatic crypto payment processing and instant product delivery mean that creators can focus on creating content, not managing payment platforms. And with Cloudflare Workers and Google Apps Script, creators can automate tasks and workflows, streamlining their business operations.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

The practical steps to infrastructure sovereignty start with choosing where your data lives. In Stack 01, orders are stored in Google Sheets — your Google account, your data, exportable at any time. In Stack 02, orders are stored in Supabase — your Supabase account, PostgreSQL database, full SQL access, exportable at any time. Product files in Stack 01 live in Google Drive — your Google account, 15GB free, shared via time-limited links generated by Apps Script. In Stack 02, files live in Cloudflare R2 — your Cloudflare account, 10GB free, zero egress fees, presigned URLs with configurable expiry.
What does sovereign commerce infrastructure mean for digital creators?

The most important question digital creators should ask is, 'What options do I have for building, deploying, and scaling my store infrastructure, and which one is right for me?' With COREMERCH's sovereign commerce infrastructure, creators can choose from three options: the Sovereign Starter Stack, the Edge Commerce Stack, and the Complete Builder Kit. Each option provides a different level of functionality, customization, and scalability, so creators can choose the one that best fits their needs.
No KYC means no geographic gatekeeping — anyone in the world can pay you without creating an account or verifying identity.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

For digital creators who want to build, deploy, and scale their store infrastructure quickly and easily, the Complete Builder Kit is the perfect solution. With this comprehensive toolkit, creators get instant access to all 6 blueprints and 7 templates, allowing them to build, deploy, and scale their store infrastructure in just a few clicks. And with Cloudflare Workers and Google Apps Script, creators can automate tasks and workflows, streamlining their business operations and reducing the risk of downtime. Plus, with a one-time payment of $197, creators get lifetime access to our documentation, source code, and community support, making it an incredibly cost-effective solution for their online business. Visit the COREMERCH shop at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to learn more and get started today.
Your Deployment Checklist

To get started with COREMERCH's sovereign commerce infrastructure, follow these steps: Choose the right option for your store infrastructure needs: the Sovereign Starter Stack, the Edge Commerce Stack, or the Complete Builder Kit. Deploy your store infrastructure using Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. Configure your payment processing using NOWPayments. Automate tasks and workflows using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Monitor and maintain your store infrastructure using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Scale your store infrastructure as needed using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. And finally, customize your store infrastructure to your needs using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script.
